capabilities.description: Sync status and manual sync trigger for PublicMetaDB list imports.
Fetches the configured PublicMetaDB lists and registers their titles as virtual media in the chosen libraries.

fields.description: Your PublicMetaDB API key (publicmetadb.com → account settings). Used to read your lists.
fields.label: PublicMetaDB API Key

fields.description: One PublicMetaDB list ID per line (the ID in the list URL, e.g. pvg2vr8nuvkh2g5).
fields.label: PMDB List IDs

fields.description: TMDB API key (v3) or read access token (v4). Used for title metadata and TMDB → IMDb resolution.
fields.label: TMDB API Key

fields.description: Destination Vio Movies library. Create a virtual one at Settings → Libraries with the "Add Virtual" button if needed.
fields.label: Movies Library

fields.description: Destination Vio Series library. Create a virtual one at Settings → Libraries with the "Add Virtual" button if needed.
fields.label: Series Library

fields.description: Minimum time between automatic syncs. The scheduled task skips runs inside this window; the admin page can always force a sync.
fields.label: Sync Interval (minutes)

fields.description: Where the plugin keeps its last-sync record. Defaults inside the plugin data directory.
fields.label: State File

global_config_schema.description: Which PublicMetaDB lists to import and where to put them.
global_config_schema.title: PMDB list sync

presentation.description_markdown: Reads your PublicMetaDB lists on a schedule and registers every title as zero-storage virtual media in your Movies and Series virtual libraries. Items removed from a list are removed from Vio on the next clean sync. Playback is handled by your configured virtual stream provider (e.g. Vio Virtual Library with AIOStreams).
presentation.setup_markdown: Enter your PublicMetaDB API key and one list ID per line, add a TMDB API key for metadata and IMDb resolution, then pick the destination Movies and Series virtual libraries (create them at Settings → Libraries with the "Add Virtual" button if needed). Press Sync Now on the PMDB Lists admin page to run the first import.
presentation.summary: Import PublicMetaDB lists as virtual media libraries.
